objective: A quick daily measurement beat. One focused, fast problem per objective — produce evidence of what the student can do today. No teaching, no warm-up items: each problem goes straight at its objective at grade level.

notes: The tasks practise a different skill from the objective. Every task must make the learner do exactly what the objective says.

multiple_choice | What happens to butter left in the warm sun? | options=[{text=Melted into liquid}, {text=Stayed the same}, {text=Turned into rock}]

objective: Develop automaticity with addition facts for sums up to 20. Focus: Rapid retrieval of basic addition math facts. Examples: 9+9, 8+7, 6+6, 5+9, 7+8, 9+6, 4+9, 8+8. Constraints: Timed mode enabled in math-fact-fluency, focus on doubles and near-doubles.
